source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-11 from the quadratic character of GF(73) alone. The 73 x 73 array has entry 1 at row x and column y when x + y is a nonzero square modulo 73 and 0 when it is a non-square. The 73 cells with x + y = 0, where the character is not defined, are left free. With those cells unknown, 4380 patterns on sets of four columns are not covered by the other rows, and every one of them can be covered by 2 or 3 choices of free cells (programs/need.c lists them). A simulated annealing search over the 73 free cells and 5 added rows, one cell changed per move, cost the number of listed patterns still uncovered (programs/ls.c, command ls 73 5 need73.txt 0.35 4000000000 3), reached 0 after 1,487,564 moves. Its output is programs/patch_m5_seed3.txt and programs/build.py writes the array from it. Two of the five added rows are constant. Exact check with ca_verify, all 4-sets
construction: Cyclotomic (quadratic character) array for q = 73 with its 73 diagonal cells chosen by search and 5 rows added by simulated annealing
notes: answers the cited size 78 at k = 72 with one more column; no Torres-Jimenez array is an ingredient or start
